page.layout: Running head top centre; page number top left. Two columns of list text separated by a vertical rule: left column years 1486 to 1493 with names; right column 1494 to 1505 with names, then an italic note at the foot of the column. Catchword at the lower right. No margin notes.

p.i: Uterque hoc anno Hovetman-nus simul & Senator.

page.notes: The catchword at the lower right is cut off at the edge of the scan; "Hi" is the visible part, so it is marked as doubtful. The years are set as lines of a list between ruled lines and are transcribed as such. The italic note at the foot of the right column is treated as a footnote to the 1505 entries. Some ink spots and faint marks in the centre of the page are not printed text and are omitted.
